methodology.walkingMatrix: OpenStreetMap routed-foot OSRM; full directed distance/duration matrix in 45x45 blocks
methodology.routeOrder: Fixed candidate START/GOAL, nearest-neighbor seed, 2-opt on walking duration
methodology.search: Seeded simulated annealing using one-embassy moves, 2-4 nearby embassy cluster moves, and swaps; nine runs per profile
methodology.stationSelection: Best walking-duration pair among stations already verified in v0.1; traffic convenience requires PM review
methodology.dailyComfortAdjustment: Candidate C starts from B and moves the adjacent Cuba/Palau pair from Day4 to Day6 to reduce practical per-day load
methodology.comparisonOnly: Profile coefficients rank candidates and do not prove a global optimum
methodology.walkingCaveat: Walking estimates exclude stamp, photo, entrance, signal, lunch, and rest time
